retro_reasoning: Reviewer flagged retro_required=yes (should-fix findings recur a previously-banked lesson: pending-row reconcile bypass). Not run this session per the standing 'Retro discipline — OFF by default, manual-only' policy; the lesson is already captured in project memory (new-pending-field-needs-both-reconcile-branches.md) and the fix applied here is a direct instance of applying it, not a new pattern needing a fresh memory write.
resolution: All 3 should-fix applied before push: (1) the sendReaction/pollReactionRefresh race — added _reactionSendCompletedAt (Map<id, Date.now()>) alongside the existing _reactionSendInflight Set; pollReactionRefresh now snapshots fetchStartedAt BEFORE issuing its fetch and skips any id whose send settled after that snapshot, closing the window where a send resolves between the refresh fetch being issued and its (stale) response being processed; (2) pollReactionRefresh now skips any comment with prev._pending or prev._failed set, so a wholesale ingestComment replace can never bypass reconcilePending's carry-forward (media_uploads, _localPreview/_stagedFile cleanup) for an in-flight optimistic row; (3) sendReaction now resolves `state.comments.get(id) || comment` at entry instead of trusting whatever object reference its caller was holding, since pollReactionRefresh's routine wholesale replacement made a stale caller-held reference a real (if rare) way to silently drop the user's own reaction. One nit taken (added a reactionsChanged test for same-count-different-key); two nits taken as doc clarifications (pollReactionRefresh's docstring now states the 'reaction on an older page = needs reload, not lost' scope; the _reactionSendInflight+_reactionSendCompletedAt comment rewritten to explain both fields). Remaining nits (string-shaped reaction value silently normalizing to 0, no fetch timeout on the refresh poll) left as-is per reviewer's own 'take it or leave it' / 'noting only, not new' framing. Suite 743/743 green, node --check clean. Not live-verified against Substack's real API from this session (dogfood pending).
